title: Rug Rally | Free browser game | Works in Desktop, Android, ios Full screen
author: laereland
selftext:
**Game developed using:** 

* Grok 4.5/4.6 - 3D designs
* Opus 5 -   Core gameplay logics

**Workflow followed:**

Idea written in notepad

* Revolt RC inspired game with Rick and Morty colours
* Planned 3 levels - Drawn all 3 levels House, School, Office in paint
* Write a PRD document based on idea and rough diagram
* It was definitely not one shot game, i lost count of prompts and it took days during my part time to build this game

Notes:

* I focussed one feature at a time in one session
* I was surprised how Grok 4.5 or 4.6 was able to understand my intentions correctly
* I gave simple prompts, no prompt engineering techniques, loops, graphs
* Prompt is a language between AI and Human and AI has gotten so much better that simple prompts are understood correctly with current state of models

Play Rug Rally on Laereland  [https://laereland.com/games/rug-rally](https://laereland.com/games/rug-rally) and would love to hear feedback

* ios Full screen gaming requires adding website to home screen due to ios security and limitations
* Desktop and Android supports full screen gaming without any special setup.
